code: md_html(data, size, process_output, out, parser_flags, renderer_flags);
note: The markdown body consists of the single digit '6' with no trailing newline, and is passed with size 1.
md_html forwards the caller-controlled markdown buffer and length to the core parser.
md_parse stores the input pointer in ctx.text and the one-byte markdown length in ctx.size before processing document lines.
Document processing asks md_analyze_line to classify the first line starting at offset 0.
Because the line is not indented code, md_analyze_line probes whether it starts a container block.
The digit at offset 0 is consumed as a possible ordered-list marker, incrementing off to ctx.size at end of input.
The code reads CH(off) after the digit loop without checking off < ctx->size, so an all-digit EOF line reads one byte past the markdown input buffer.
